newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION SALES UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION SALES UP IN APRIL.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Tuesday that quarrying and manufacturing production sales rose by 11 percent in April.
The department also said in a statement that sales in the first four months of 1997 were down 1.9 percent compared to the same period last year.
The department did not provide any total sales figures in litas.
It also said that the fastest growth was in the leather production sector, which saw its sales rise by 29.2 percent in April.
Sales in refined oil products rose by 24.2 percent in April, the statistics department said.
